# IPV4\_INT\_SIZE variable

Bytes in a binary IPv4 address: 4.

**Signature:**

```typescript
IPV4_INT_SIZE = 4
```

## Remarks

The unit every IPv4 buffer in this package is measured in — see [sizeOf()](/api/net/latest/net.sizeof/)<!-- -->, which selects between this and [IPV6\_INT\_SIZE](/api/net/latest/net.ipv6_int_size/) by [NetworkType](/api/net/latest/net.networktype/)<!-- -->.
